st: From ever-faster routines to mental exercises for slowing down a moment

sec.p: Time. What a lovely topic this one is too. You find it discussed practically everywhere, from philosophy to Jovanotti's pop songs. From theoretical physics to ephemeral tissues for a cold. Ephemeral indeed.
I don't get it. If we're old, there's less novelty and change, so time passes faster? Doesn't that contradict everything we said about the dynamic circle?
Freezing moments. To give value to time (and stretch it even when novelty isn't a given), storyteller Matthew Dicks suggests some homework.

sec.t: ff.65.4 A matter of the heart?
sec.p: Il tempo si espande o si blocca in accordo con i movimenti del cuore. Murakami,Kafka sulla spiaggia
